description: This file implements classes related to AWC (possibly 'Android Window Controller' or similar) for process container management, including notifier and listener classes that handle state change notifications and window events.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Class responsible for managing listeners and notifying them of state changes.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Class that listens for window and state change events and forwards notifications.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the notifier if it is not already registered.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from the notifier.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a state change.

methods.name: AWCListener
methods.description: Constructor for AWCListener, initializes with a notifier.

methods.name: notifyWindowChange
methods.description: Placeholder for window change notifications, intentionally left empty.

methods.name: notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications and forwards them to the notifier.

methods.name: notifyServiceReady
methods.description: Placeholder for service ready notification, currently does nothing.
